summary: @remindhq I have believed in SMS teaching as an equity issue since replicating the iReady study as part of #GearUpWorks. I will volunteer to help any district adapt their pedagogy or develop #CCSS by SMS curriculum.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @remindhq I have believed in SMS teaching as an equity issue since replicating the iReady study as part of #GearUpWorks. I will volunteer to help any district adapt their pedagogy or develop #CCSS by SMS curriculum.
